memberdef.name: parseScalarValue

briefdescription.para: parseScalarValue - A common parsing routine for all flow scalar styles.

detaileddescription.para: It handles line break characters by itself, adds regular content characters to the result, and forwards escaped sequences to the provided routine for the style-specific processing.

parameterdescription.para: - An input value without quotation marks.
- A storage for the result if the input value is multiline or contains escaped characters.
- A set of special characters to search in the input string. Should include line break characters and the escape character specific for the processing scalar style, if any.
- This is called when the escape character is found in the input.
